selection_provenance: Three bases nominated after rounds one and two were evaluated; this is not an independent confirmation.

event_settings.target_count: spatially weighted median of revealed profile event counts
event_settings.adaptive_validation: leave one revealed location and its entire near group / colocated supports out; IDW amplitude proxy, not residual predictions
event_settings.adaptive_tie_break: lowest tau, then lowest cardinality cost
event_settings.query_information: geometry and frozen legitimate base predictions only
event_settings.source_scope: Indicator interpolation and structured CPT labeling motivate an original small Gibbs model; not reproductions of indicator kriging or HMRF papers.

additional_hyperparameter_search: none; only replace the amplitude base in two existing fixed decoders
native_probability: recompute exact marginals under the Gibbs model using each new amplitude base
point_thickness: computed only from actual decoded point qc < 1 MPa; not expected thickness
